nl: Undo the last commit 'Unfinished parser change' but keep its changes staged in the index and in the working tree.

setup.description: A Git repository whose newest commit must be undone.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# job-2
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v7'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'X = 1
' > 'src/new2.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Unfinished parser change'
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# job-2
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v7'')
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/new2.py'), 'X = 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Unfinished parser change'
